title: Introduce invocation waveform panel and compact span digests for efficient long-tail inspection
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added an Invocation Waveform dashboard panel and a compact span digest format to enable fast long-tail inspection and lower trace storage costs. Feature rolls out behind a flag; opt-in required.
body: Context: Long-tail invocations with bursty token timing are a major source of manual investigation time. Full-span traces are expensive and hard to scan; our current sampling discards shape information. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) a compact span digest produced at request completion that preserves per-token timing waveform and a small set of heavy-span anchors, and (2) a new Grafana "Invocation Waveform" panel that surfaces per-invocation timing shapes alongside existing token-cost and latency breakdowns. Motivation: help SREs and platform engineers triage noisy SLO regressions and cost spikes without pulling full trace payloads, reduce storage and query costs, and provide a stable signal for alert tuning. Design: compact span digest schema encodes a fixed-length downsampled token timing vector (up to 128 points), key annotations (top-3 heavy spans by wall time), simple summary stats (p50/p90/p99, kurtosis, skew), and a tiny provenance header (model, route, tenant, sequence-length). The digest is compressed using snappy and base64-encoded so it can be attached to traces and indexed as a short text blob. The export path: runtime collects per-token timers (micros) with a low-overhead aggregator that intermittently rolls into the digest buffer; on invocation end we produce the compact digest and emit it via the tracing exporter. The trace-indexer decodes digests and populates three new fields: waveform_blob, waveform_stats, waveform_shingles (for quick similarity search). A new Waveform panel queries these fields and renders a sparkline with percentile bands; hover shows the decompressed digest and heavy-span anchors. Rollout plan: feature gated by "waveform_rollout" and off by default; enabled for 10% of tenants initially. Alerting: introduced a candidate alert adjustment that uses waveform_kurtosis to suppress noisy low-amplitude p99 spikes; we add an opt-in smoother for SLO rules to reduce alerting on shape-preserved spikes. Backwards compatibility: digests are optional; older indexers ignore unknown fields. Migration: indexer and exporter handle missing digest gracefully. Tests: unit tests for encoder/decoder, integration tests exercising end-to-end export -> index -> dashboard, dashboard snapshot tests. Checklist: - [x] runtime encoder/decoder implementation - [x] trace exporter wiring - [x] indexer decode + new fields - [x] Grafana panel and dashboard JSON - [x] unit & integration tests - [x] rollout flag and metrics to track adoption - [x] docs PR draft (will follow, link in comments). Related: builds on prior work around token rollups and span-synthesis but focuses on compact shape retention rather than full trace expansion. Commits: summary: 1) add waveform proto and runtime hooks 2) implement snappy compressor for compact digest 3) indexer: decode and index waveform fields 4) grafana: add waveform panel and helper lint 5) add tests and feature-flagging. Changed files (high level): - runtime/telemetry/waveform_encoder.go (core encoder) - runtime/telemetry/exporter_tracing.go (emit digest on finish) - trace/indexer/waveform_indexer.go (decode + index) - grafana/dashboards/invocation_waveform.json (new panel) - infra/featureflags.yaml (waveform_rollout flag) - tests/integration/waveform_e2e_test.go - docs/observability/waveform.md (initial draft) Review notes: The description above is intentionally condensed; see inline comments for API details and benchmarks.

reviews: Liam O'Connor: Nice approach. Two asks: (1) add a microbenchmark for encoder overhead at p50/p95 QPS, (2) ensure the base64 blobs are capped and never exceed 4KB per invocation. Please add tests for both.

merge_summary: Squash-merged after approvals. Added waveform encoder/decoder, indexer support and Grafana panel. Rollout behind feature flag. Tracked metrics: waveform.encode.success, waveform.encode.size_bytes, waveform.index.latency.
post_merge_actions: Monitor waveform.encode.size_bytes for >90th percentile; abort rollout if average >2KB
